question: Separate natal YueDe/TianDe geometry from received-Fullbook annual YueDe/TianDe scope without collapsing same-name facts or changing production defaults.

direct_text_controls.text: 天德星从酉上起子，顺数至流年太岁上是也。
月德星从子上起子，顺数至流年太岁上是也。
解神从戌上起子，逆数至当生年太岁上是也。
欲求天德顺从酉，月德要依巳顺逢。

philology.controlling_contrast: 同一 received-Fullbook 局部段落把天德、月德明确系于流年太岁，而把解神明确系于当生年太岁；因此不能把三者统一解释为出生年输入。
philology.same_name_rule: 同名不等于同时层；本命 STAR.YUEDE/STAR.TIANDE 与流年候选 STAR.YUEDE/STAR.TIANDE 必须按 source_layer 分离。
philology.shenfeng_scope: 《神峰通考》可证明巳起月德/酉起天德的前现代几何传统，但不能单独证明紫微本命采纳史。
philology.jielan_boundary: Reviewed public surfaces did not yield a reliably edition-bound 1581 Jielan passage for these exact TianDe/YueDe formulas. A public page labelled as Jielan internally reproduces Fullbook/Nanyangtang framing and is excluded from early-print attestation.
